name: Aierdi De Wanyan
source:
They all actually wanted to kill you!? Whether as lovers or enemies, it seems to be tied to your past before the amnesia.

[Roughly translated from [url=https://942320122.itch.io/2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他们居然都想杀了你！？无论是恋人还是敌人，似乎都与失忆前的过去联系在一起。

[大致翻译自 [url=https://942320122.itch.io/2]Itch.io[/url]]
